name: DRAF + parallel/MoE/SFT laws (off-task)
tagline: Mis-targets the wrong scaling-law families (parallel/MoE/SFT instead of vocab/lrbsz/dataconstrained), with a dual log+linear residual fitter and a 3-form MoE model selector.
diff_from_baseline: The submission redefines the data-loading functions and law families to sld-parallel/sld-moe/sld-sft; for the actual benchmarks (sld-vocab, sld-lrbsz, sld-dataconstrained) it provides no fitter and would error at run time. Only the dual-residual fitter is reusable across families.

name: Vocab law + V·D cross term
tagline: Per-group nonlinear LSQ with paper-style laws plus an extra V^-c·D^-d cross term for vocab; multiple paper-init restarts for lrbsz; multi-start TRF/soft_l1.
formula: $$ L_{\text{vocab}} = E + A N^{-\alpha} + B V^{-\beta} + C D^{-\gamma} + F\,V^{-\beta_2}D^{-\gamma_2} $$ $$ L_{\text{lrbsz}} = A D^{-\alpha} + B N^{-\beta} + C + D_{lr}(\text{lr} - l_0)^2 + E[\log b + b_0/b],\quad l_0 = F N^\gamma D^\zeta,\; b_0 = G D^\eta $$ $$ L_{\text{dataconstrained}} = E + A N^{-\alpha} + B D_{\text{eff}}^{-\beta},\quad D_{\text{eff}} = U(1-e^{-D/U}) $$

key_hyperparams.name: TRF n_restarts
key_hyperparams.value: 8 perturbed inits each with shrinking sigma

diff_from_baseline: Extends the human_exact baseline's vocab law with an extra V^-c·D^-d cross interaction; reuses the SLDBench Expert-B form for lrbsz with 3 parameter inits and paper-style D_eff for dataconstrained. Linear (not log) residual loss with TRF+soft_l1.

name: Four-term tensor-power vocab + asymmetric lr/bsz manifold
tagline: Treats vocab loss as a sum of four learned N^a·V^b·D^c power tensors; lr/bsz uses an asymmetric exp-penalty manifold with N,D-tied optima; data-constrained adds a second U^-f tail.
formula: $$ L_{\text{vocab}} = E + \sum_{k=1}^{4} A_k\, N^{a_k} V^{b_k} D^{c_k} \quad (a_k,b_k,c_k \in [-5, 5]) $$ $$ L_{\text{lrbsz}} = E + AN^{-a} + BD^{-b} + C N^{-a} D^{-b} + K_1[e^{K_a x} - K_a x - 1] + K_2 y^2 + K_3 xy $$ $$ \text{with }x=\log\tfrac{lr}{l_0 N^{g_l} D^{d_l}},\; y=\log\tfrac{bsz}{b_0 N^{g_b} D^{d_b}} $$ $$ L_{\text{dc}} = E + AN^{-a} + B D_{\text{eff}}^{-b} + F U^{-f},\; D_{\text{eff}} = D / (c_1 r^\rho + 1)^{1/\rho} + c_2 D,\; r = D/U $$

key_hyperparams.name: lrbsz manifold
key_hyperparams.role: asymmetric exp-style lr penalty + correlated bsz term

diff_from_baseline: Versus the baseline SLDBench/human_exact laws, the vocab form adds three extra tensor-product power terms (instead of the 3-axis additive form), the lrbsz form uses an asymmetric exp-Bregman lr penalty plus rotated quadratic, and dataconstrained adds a U^-f tail and a soft-OR effective tokens.

name: Bottleneck-renormalized scaling laws
tagline: Vocab dilutes data via D_eff = D/V^φ; lr/bsz uses a coupled (lr*, bsz*) manifold with asymmetric batch penalty; data-constrained uses sublinear repeat utility.
formula: $$ L_{\text{vocab}} = E + A N^{-\alpha} + B (D/V^\phi)^{-\beta} + C V^{-\gamma} $$ $$ L_{\text{lrbsz}} = E + A N^{-\alpha} + B D^{-\beta} + K_{lr}(\log lr - \log lr_0 - \rho \Delta\log b)^2 + K_b\,(x + e^{-x} - 1) $$ $$ \text{with } \log lr_0 = \ell_0 + \gamma \log N + \zeta \log D,\; \log b_0 = m_0 + \eta\log N + \theta\log D,\; x = \log b - \log b_0 $$ $$ L_{\text{dc}} = E + A N^{-\alpha} + B D_{\text{eff}}^{-\beta} + C U^{-\gamma},\;\; D_{\text{eff}} = U\,((1+D/U)^r - 1)/r $$

key_hyperparams.name: rho
key_hyperparams.role: lr/batch coupling on the optimizer manifold

init_recovers: Human/Chinchilla laws when phi→0 (vocab), rho→0 (lrbsz), r→1 (dc)
diff_from_baseline: Versus human_exact, replaces vocab's additive V^-β with V-renormalized data D/V^φ, replaces the Expert-B law's independent (lr−l0)^2 + log b + b0/b with a single coupled (log lr, log b) manifold and an asymmetric batch penalty, and replaces saturating effective tokens with a generalized power-law saturation parameter r.

name: Joint-synergy vocab + lr/bsz bowl with data-tied optima (broken)
tagline: Adds N·V cross + saturating data + two power cross-terms for vocab; lr/bsz bowl with D-dependent (lr0, bsz0) and rho coupling; data-constrained adds repetition penalty. Submission has a syntax error and missing ScalingLawModel class.
formula: $$ L_{\text{vocab}} = E + A N^{-\alpha} V^{-\beta} + B(1 - e^{-D/d_0})^\gamma + C N^{-a_2} D^{-g_1} + D_c V^{-v_2} D^{-g_2} $$ $$ L_{\text{lrbsz}} = E + A N^{-\alpha} + B D^{-\beta} + \tfrac{K}{2}(dx^2 + dy^2 + 2\rho\, dx\, dy) $$ $$ \text{with }dx = \log lr - (L_1 + L_2 \log D),\; dy = \log b - (B_1 + B_2 \log D) $$ $$ L_{\text{dc}} = E + A N^{-\alpha} + B D_{\text{eff}}^{-\beta} + C_2 r^{-E_2},\;\; D_{\text{eff}} = U(1-e^{-D/U})^\delta / (1 + R\,(\max(r-1, 0))^{rp}) $$
diff_from_baseline: Adds a cross N^-a V^-b term and a saturating data term to the vocab law; uses a correlated (lr, bsz) bowl with optima sliding in log D; adds a multiplicative repetition penalty to D_eff for dataconstrained. The submission is incomplete: _fit_lrbsz contains an unterminated np.array literal and the file no longer defines class ScalingLawModel, so it would fail at import.
